rules.description: EXAMPLE — not a recommendation: format fixture for A10/X1. BTC spot-ETF net inflows are a market-wide risk-on signal (§2.2 X1); this rule goes long when the trailing 5-day flow is strongly positive and invalidates on a sharp single-day reversal. Not backtested; status stays "experimental" until Gate D0/D1.

EXAMPLE — not a recommendation: format fixture for A10/X2. Encodes "no new entries within 24h of a scheduled macro event" as an entry gate rather than a separate blocking mechanism (this engine only expresses entry rules): entryWhenAll requires both hoursToNextFomc and hoursToNextCpi to exceed 24h, so the rule simply cannot trigger — and therefore proposes no new plan — inside that 24h pre-event window; a modest already-trending filter (return1d > 0) supplies the rest of the entry thesis so the example has a real signal, not just a calendar gate. Not backtested.

EXAMPLE — not a recommendation: format fixture for A10/X4. Extreme positive funding (>95th percentile of the trailing 90 days) implies crowded leveraged longs; this rule fades that crowding with a short, and invalidates once funding normalizes back under the 50th percentile. Not backtested.
